parameters.name: ascOrder
parameters.description: Specifies whether to sort the results in ascending order.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date for which to retrieve statistics. The date must be in `YYYYMMdd` format.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: partitionPrefix
parameters.description: The partition name. This parameter supports fuzzy matching.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The schema that contains the table.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can find this ID in the MaxCompute console by navigating to **Tenant Management** > **Tenant Properties**.
